title: Jujutsu Kaisen
subtitle: Cursed energy, resolved will
description: High school student Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed finger to save his friends, becoming the host of the most powerful curse in existence, and begins training as a jujutsu sorcerer.
quotes: I don't need a reason to save people. I just save them because they're there.
You're strong. That's your flaw. You're too strong, so you've forgotten what it means to be weak.
When it comes to you, I want to be the strongest. That's my selfishness.
